dedupe_keys.name: three trondheim wood stove homes room climate heat and electric power

description: This Mendeley Data collection contains sub-hourly operational measurements from three Trondheim homes heated by wood stoves and direct electric panels. SusWoodStoves researchers released separate raw and processed Excel workbooks for each home, plus a supplementary description. The article identifies room-level indoor temperature, air quality, stove-surface temperature, space-heating power, household electric power and outdoor conditions. Current version 5 is public under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is three participating Norwegian houses, not a representative residential stock or an entire district-heating network. Occupant behaviour, stove use, building fabric and monitoring gaps may affect comparisons across homes. A reviewer-assessed use is checking thermal-zone or behind-the-meter electricity simulations that represent solid-fuel heating. model-energyplus is a related building simulator, but no direct model import, parameter calibration or seasonal normalisation was checked. The repository lists seven files; no spreadsheet or PDF was downloaded.
